kpi_dictionary.Bank Cash Runway: Liquid checking buffer (19 days) based on actual average monthly operational spend.
kpi_dictionary.Total Reserve Runway: Total available liquidity including the Fidelity board-designated operating reserve (4.0 months).
kpi_dictionary.Accounts Payable: Legitimate current rolling vendor payables ($3,533.11 across all 19 scheduled vendor lines: Top 8 Primary $2,739.76 + Remaining Aging $793.35).
